_comment: Short names for `python -m fl_tools experiment <name>`. 'family' is matched against the models Ollama has installed (e.g. qwen2.5-coder matches qwen2.5-coder:latest). num_ctx is applied by creating a variant of the model automatically.

qwen35.note: newer Qwen; may 'think' before answering (slow, can use up the token budget). extra_body tries to switch thinking off; preflight warns if replies come back empty. Try --n 10 first.

llama31.note: general-purpose Llama 3.1 8B, the comparison point from the FlexFL paper
